description: A `given x :> body` arm of a `match` fires when `x` is present — as a decl-position value (`let out = match …`), a `return match` value, and a statement-position match whose braced arms `return`.
rationale: §42.2.3 "In match arms, the presence pattern in a `match` block uses `given`" (`not :> handleAbsence()` / `given x :> handlePresence(x)`). impl#1 parsed a brace-less `given` arm body as a sibling statement and every match lowering skipped the `given-guard` node, so the present case fell through: the value was `not` and the statement arm never ran (g-impl1-given-match-arm-body-dropped-s462).
